HushThreads v0.0.12 has 17 patches for Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it works with Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85 too. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so you need Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer.

Six patches are new in this one, Save photos and videos, Max image quality, Disable screenshot detection, Change version code, Remove share targets and Trust user-added certificates. HushThreads also has its own row in Threads' settings now, and Hide ads catches more of the ad units in your feed.

## Threads

- New Trust user-added certificates patch, not selected by default. Threads accepts certificates you've installed on your phone yourself, such as one a work network needs or a debugging proxy's, wherever it relies on Android's own certificate checks. Threads' network code checks Meta's certificates on its own as well and this patch doesn't change that, so a proxy still can't read most of Threads' traffic to Meta. HushThreads settings list it under Set when you patched.
- New Remove share targets patch, not selected by default. Threads stops showing up in the share sheet other apps open, so it isn't offered when you share a link, a photo or a video from somewhere else. The patch takes Threads' share entries out of its manifest, and any direct share contacts Threads might list there go too. Sharing from Threads to other apps still works. HushThreads settings list it under Set when you patched.
- New Change version code patch, not selected by default. It raises the patched Threads' version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Every build with the patch has that same code, so an older Threads patched with it installs over a newer one too. Threads' own checks of its version code, at start and in its job scheduler, still see the code Meta built. Going back to stock Threads afterwards means uninstalling first, which deletes Threads' data, and later HushThreads builds need the patch too.
- Hide ads now also takes out the feed units Threads itself marks as ads by their unit type, even when the post inside doesn't carry the ad flag. That covers plain ads, ads for ads, the two kinds of ad pivot and the ads feedback prompts. Suggested accounts and other recommendation units stay, and so do ordinary posts. The Hide ads switch covers both checks.
- New Max image quality patch, off by default in Manager. Threads gets every photo in several sizes and normally loads the one closest to your screen's width. With this on it loads the largest size it has, so photos look sharper and each one is a bigger download. Square crops stay square and nothing changes size on screen. The switch is under Feed in HushThreads settings as Full size photos, and turning it off or pausing HushThreads gives Threads its own choice back.
- New Disable screenshot detection patch, off by default in Manager. Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops looking through your photos for new screenshots, and on Android 14 and newer it doesn't ask Android to report screenshots of the feed. Your screenshots are still saved. The switch sits in HushThreads' Privacy settings, and turning it off or pausing HushThreads gives Threads its own behavior back.
- Restore screens on re-signed builds now also covers FBNS, the push service Meta's apps share. FBNS checks the app's own signing certificate before it hands it pushes, and on a re-signed build it now gets Threads' original certificate there too, the same way Threads' other security checks already did. Refs #6.
- New Save photos and videos patch, selected by default. A post's menu gets a Save row right under Copy link, with Threads' own download icon. It reads Save photo, Save video or Save all, depending on what the post holds, and posts without a photo or video don't get it. A tap saves to your gallery, photos to Pictures/Threads and videos to Movies/Threads with their sound, at the best size Threads has. A carousel saves every page in order, photos and videos alike, and its files carry the post's id so two posts never mix. The menu closes once the save starts, as it does after Copy link. A new Downloads page in HushThreads settings has the switch plus quality, folder and file name options, and it shows how the last carousel save went. Pause takes the row away too.
- HushThreads now has its own row in Threads' settings, right above More settings, so you can open it from your profile's settings like any other page. It's drawn the way Threads draws its own rows. It grows with large text, and TalkBack reads it out and opens it with a double tap. The launcher shortcut and Additional settings on the App info page still work.
- HushThreads now patches Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (version code 512008342, the 240-480dpi build) as well as 449 and 448. Threads 450 rearranged the code behind three patches. Disable video autoplay now finds the flag PostVideo plays by from the check that sets the player going, Block background-return feed refresh follows the warm-start check's new branch and the second server setting 450 can read its time limit from, and Pure black dark mode also looks in the helper where 450 builds its dark colors.
- If Threads draws its settings before HushThreads has started, the HushThreads row is left out of that one draw and comes back on the next, instead of staying hidden until Threads restarts.
- On a Threads build whose settings screen has changed so the HushThreads row can't go in, the settings patch now leaves the row out and says why in the patch log, instead of failing and taking every other patch with it. HushThreads still opens from its launcher shortcut and App info.

## Tooling

- A fixture test decodes the network security config of 450, 449 and 448 and checks that the user entry lands in its base trust anchors and nothing else in the file changes.
- A fixture test decodes the manifest of 450, 449 and 448 and checks that the share handler's two share filters are the only thing that goes, and that the entry Threads uses to share out to other apps stays.
- A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that Threads' own reads of its version code go through HushThreads with their own registers, that the start-up and job scheduler checks are among them, that the two reads meant to see the raised code are left alone, and that the decoded manifest changes in its version code and nowhere else.
- A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that the unit type is read from the feed item's own field, the one its feedItemType getter reads, and that the field's enum names every ad kind. A unit test drops the ad unit types and keeps NETEGO and SUGGESTED units and ordinary posts.
- A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that Threads' one photo size chooser asks the extension for its target width first thing, and that the answer lands in the register the chooser reads that width from. The patch refuses when the chooser isn't there exactly once or reads the width anywhere else.
- A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that the photo library observer and the screenshot folder report each ask the extension before anything else, with the register they borrow unused at that point, and that Threads' one request to Android goes through the extension with the same arguments.
- A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that FBNS's check hashes the certificate HushThreads answers, read straight after its own read with nothing else moved, and that a check read twice or into the wrong register stops the patch.
- The save engine and its tests come from HushGram, with per-file provenance. A fixture test checks on 450, 449 and 448 that the Save row goes in only on Copy link's own path and is drawn with the calls Copy link uses. Every other branch in the menu still lands where it did, including 450's, where another row shares Copy link's drawing call. It refuses to patch when Copy link is checked twice, a branch jumps into its case, the menu's composer or own parameters get overwritten, or the menu closes some other way. Apart from the release check, the downloader is the only code that opens its own connection, and the hosts test now holds both to that.
- A fixture test checks on 449 and 448 that the row goes in only where Threads draws More settings, hands Threads its own composer and modifier, and refuses to patch when that entry moves, its composer gets overwritten or a branch jumps into it.
- The fixture tests run on 450, 449 and 448. On 450 they check the playback effect's new parameters, the warm-start check that jumps to its log and back, the time limit read from either of two keys and the dark colors built in a helper.
- Disable video autoplay now also checks that the flag it finds turns a video on when true and off when false, so a Threads build wired the other way round is refused instead of getting a switch that works backwards.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.12 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (version code 512008342), 449.0.0.54.82 (version code 511908382) or 448.0.0.54.85 (version code 511808302). Not sure which? Take 449. Its bundle fits every screen, and the 450 one only covers 240 to 480dpi.
3. Eight patches aren't selected by default, so tick the ones you want in Manager before you patch: Block background-return feed refresh, Change version code, Disable screenshot detection, Disable video autoplay, Max image quality, Pure black dark mode, Remove share targets and Trust user-added certificates.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. Sign in with your Instagram username and password. If you patch Instagram with [HushGram](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram) using the same signing key, you can tap your Instagram account on Threads' login screen instead.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

804 runtime tests and 212 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 17 patches applied without forcing to Threads 450.0.0.51.78, 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85, and the release receipt records all three runs. The dependency advisory check passed.

## What's new

- **Hide Stories tray** is a new patch. The row of stories at the top of the feed goes away, Create story included, the way Facebook builds the feed when its own tray is off. Stories still open from profiles, notifications and the Stories viewer.
- **"Suggested for you"** has its own switch in Hide suggested and promoted posts. It hides the posts Facebook recommends from people and pages you don't follow and from groups you haven't joined, going by the same flag Facebook's own "hide suggested posts" reads. Posts from friends, followed pages and your groups stay.
- **"People you may know"** has a switch of its own too, and friend requests are left alone.
- **Hide AI-detected posts** is a new patch that hides posts Facebook's own detection labelled as made with AI. Its switch starts off.
- **Download any video** adds Download to phone to the menu of feed and Watch videos, through the same checked downloader stories and reels use. A Save folder setting names the folder saves go to.
- **Material You theme** gives Facebook's dark mode your wallpaper's colours on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is, and it works alone or with AMOLED black theme.
- **Sanitize sharing links** takes the tracking tags Facebook adds to shared and copied links back off, and links that open in your browser lose their fbclid tag.
- Hushfacebook's own text, launcher shortcut included, is in the language Facebook shows, and a settings file with a number too large to read is refused with a message.
- Each release now carries a CycloneDX SBOM of the bundle, and a release stops on a known advisory nobody has looked at.
- Built with Morphe patcher 1.14.1, so this bundle needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.

## Validation

- 372 runtime tests and 106 patch tests passed locally, with both Android lint checks clean.
- All 18 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 without forced compatibility mode or manifest changes.

The `.mpp` is a Morphe patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Use Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer and keep its existing signing key when updating. The `.cdx.json` is the bundle's SBOM.

Hushfeed v0.67.1 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer.

The buttons Hushfeed draws on videos now start off, and the settings pages are regrouped so related switches sit together. If you used the mute button, turn it back on under Feed screen > Buttons on videos.

## What's changed

* Settings are easier to find. All five buttons Hushfeed draws on videos sit together under Feed screen > Buttons on videos. Playback now holds every player switch, including the progress bar and its thumbnail, stop looping and resume after scrolling, which were on App. Screenshots and the status bar moved to App > System along with Look like the store app. Allow Duet and Stitch is on Share sheet now. Your saved choices stay as they were.
* Every button Hushfeed draws on videos now starts off: block, hide, block sound, Not interested and mute. A fresh install shows none of them until you turn one on under Feed screen > Buttons on videos. If you used the mute button, turn on Show the mute button on videos again.
* Remove unused language packs no longer stops the whole patch run when Languages to keep is left at all and the APK carries a language set that hasn't been checked, like a split bundle merged with a single language. Nothing is removed then, and the patch log says why (#96).
* The streak line under Keep a streak going says "Sent to 15/15 chats" once TikTok has taken every message. It calls delivery unconfirmed only for a chat whose hand-off hit an error or never finished (#92).
* Show the hide button and Show the block sound button now draw their own feed controls even when Show the block button is off. Both work through Feed filter, so they're listed only when that patch is in. New installs start those two helper switches off, so choosing Block author button doesn't add extra chips until you ask for them (#95).
* Pause keeps the saved Home long-press shortcut available, so guests can reopen settings and resume Hushfeed after closing the screen. A disabled shortcut stays disabled, ordinary Home taps still work, and TikTok's own long-press action is preserved (#89).
* Settings on Android 6 use the shipped languages' plural forms, including Russian one, few and many. Missing quantity translations fall back to English with the right singular form. Newer Android versions keep their own ICU rules.
* What's new keeps its full release history as the text grows. Large notes and international text no longer exceed Java's single-string build limit.
* Morphe Manager 1.33.0 shows all 106 patches in their ten categories, with nothing left uncategorized. The checks run before each build now cover single-ABI inputs on every supported TikTok version and reject altered native libraries or an empty patch result. Published bundles can be checked against GitHub release attestations or a pinned signing key.
* Limit background traffic keeps push setup intact by default, including when All is selected. Its optional Skip push setup choice starts off and can stop message and other notifications when enabled. Existing APKs need repatching from TikTok's original APK to restore push setup. Pause can't reverse this patch-time change (#86).
* Restoring settings now reports keys the current build can't restore, separately from settings missing from an older backup. Portable settings still migrate across TikTok versions, local device state stays intact, and Feature Gate Lab compatibility and Undo keep their existing behavior.
* Feed filter's Seen videos section can import the reviewed TikTok JSON watch-history export. Watch dates and the chosen account stay attached to the import, the existing age limit applies, and a banner reports added and skipped entries. Repeating an import adds nothing. Invalid or unsupported files and failed writes leave saved history unchanged. Files are limited to 2 MB and 10,000 entries, and links never leave the phone. An import that adds history ends Undo for an earlier clear and explains that change.

## Update

Open Morphe Manager, refresh the Hushfeed source and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* 2785 runtime tests and 545 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3, the new Buttons on videos card, the regrouped pages and the hide button on its own (#95) were checked by hand.
* A TikTok 47.1.4 that carries a single language patched with every patch selected, then installed and opened (#96).

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite

#### ✨ Features
- **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key (with empty text suppression and settings toggle).
- **Enter Key Tasker Event**: Dispatches a high-priority Android Intent broadcast (`dev.custom.gboard.ENTER_PRESSED`) to Tasker whenever the Enter or IME action key is pressed, including active package, action type, and cursor text.
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Samsung Keyboard / Good Lock (Keys Cafe) style glide typing trail customization (fade speed, dynamic Rainbow RGB, color presets, stroke thickness, and tail length decay).
- **Morphe Independent Selection**: All patches can be individually enabled or combined together in Morphe Manager.

#### 📱 Add to Morphe App
1. Open the **Morphe** app on your Android device.
2. Navigate to **Settings** -> **Sources**.
3. Tap **Add Source** and paste:
   ```
   https://github.com/ausamnco/gboard-enc-patches
   ```
4. Return to **Patcher**, select Gboard, select your patches, and patch!

## BannerHub v6 1.0.0-609 > ⚠️ **Read before installing — USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** BannerHub v6 is a **separate project** from BannerHub 3.7.x and BannerHub Lite (own package names, keystore, and backend) — they do **not** update over one another, and v6 is a **work in progress, barely tested**, with different game compatibility. Full details below. ⤵
⚠️ Important — separate projects & compatibility (click to expand) **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**
A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.9** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account) and redirects the catalog to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**. **9 APKs attached.** Steam game launches work end-to-end. > **No separate Lite builds on the 6.0.9 base.** XiaoJi's own −46% size pass plus the privacy/size strips folded into every variant make the full 6.0.9 build (~55 MB) smaller than the old 6.0.4 Lite — so a distinct Lite would strip nothing extra. The Lite concept is absorbed. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-609-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account. - **Custom catalog API** — the catalog is redirected to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker for **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** (mode + intensity) via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free — no `libevshim` / `LD_PRELOAD`. - **GOG integration** — sign in to GOG, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games in-app; they're added to your GameHub library and launch like any other PC game. Reached from the Explore tab's GOG card or the Banner Tools → GOG tile. - **BannerHub Explore homepage** — the bottom-nav "Explore" tab opens a BannerHub-owned homepage instead of the stock online discovery feed: wordmark/logo hero, a "What's New" article that auto-syncs from the release notes, the GOG store card, and an in-app **update banner + installed-vs-latest version readout** with a settings cog. Content can refresh live via an external JSON override; still fully offline-capable. - **Recording-compatible audio** — optional toggle (Banner Tools → Audio) that routes PulseAudio through the mixer so screen recorders capture in-game sound. - **In-game performance overlay** *(root)* — a draggable edge pill → slide-out panel for live CPU-governor + Adreno min-clock toggles while gaming; off by default, root-gated, auto-reverts on exit. Toggle from Banner Tools → In-game Overlay. - **9 side-by-side variants** — different package names + launcher labels so multiple builds coexist on one device (`Original` replaces stock GameHub; the rest install alongside it). - **Root-free file manager access** — a content provider lets MT Manager and similar apps browse GameHub's data dir without root. - **Portrait PC-settings** — per-game PC settings render in both landscape and portrait (side benefit of the API redirect). - **Installs in place** — stable signing keystore; future BannerHub v6 stables upgrade without uninstalling. - **BannerHub v6 branding** — custom app icon, Wine container header, and auth/splash artwork. - **Triage-friendly** — debuggable build with logcat markers along the import path.
## What's new in 1.0.0-609 The headline: **the GameHub 6.0.9 rebase.** BannerHub v6 moved from the 6.0.8 base (versionCode 119) to **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.9** (versionCode 121) — XiaoJi's first feature release of the 6.0.x line. Every BannerHub patch was **re-fingerprinted against 6.0.9's reshuffled bytecode and confirmed on-device**; the full v6 feature set carries over unchanged. Same stable keystore, so it installs in place over any `…-608` build. ### 🔁 Rebased onto GameHub 6.0.9 (versionCode 121) 6.0.9 is a **feature release** upstream (native "Team Room" co-op + Tencent in-room voice) — **not** a runtime change: no Wine / DXVK / Box64 / FEX / Mesa Turnip changes, so component compatibility is unaffected. As always, the upstream R8 obfuscation reshuffle broke the usual set of patch anchors; all were **re-derived and device-verified**: - **Per-game menu chain** — the keystone per-game id capture, the Banner Tools row + consolidated dialog, the PC Vibration Settings row, Show Game ID, and the GOG row, all re-pinned (including 6.0.9's new **resource-descriptor menu-row icon model**). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — re-pinned + device-confirmed (independent dual-motor, intensity scaling, and **sustained holds** via the on-disk `winebus.so` patch). - **Offline component picker** — re-pinned **and fixed**: it now correctly lists your already-downloaded components offline (a long-standing result-wrapper bug, present since earlier bases, was caught and cured in this rebase). - **Bypass login, catalog redirect + `/v6` prefix, debug logging, Explore tab hijack, Show PC Game Settings, and the analytics/telemetry strips** — all re-pinned + verified. > **Upstream's own Team Room voice** (Tencent TRTC) ships in 6.0.9 but is gated behind XiaoJi's cloud "Instant Play" recharge service, so it never unlocks on these builds — BannerHub's WebRTC in-game voice overlay stays the working in-game voice. ### ✅ Everything carries over The full v6 feature set is intact and device-verified on 6.0.9: the **in-game Steam chat overlay + voice calls** (1:1 + party mesh, movable/collapsible call box, incoming ring with caller name + 30s auto-dismiss, ringtone settings, 🔗 share-call browser-guest link, emoji/emoticon/sticker picker + send-image via the Worker, typing indicators) — including **voice room codes** (create/join a shared room by a 5-character code, **cross-compatible with BannerHub 3.8.0** in either direction). Plus the **full Firebase Crashlytics shutoff**, GOG integration, the BannerHub Explore homepage (update banner + installed-vs-latest readout), PC-accurate controller vibration, the in-game performance overlay (root), recording-compatible audio, the offline component picker, portrait PC-settings, and the rest of the privacy-hardening stack — all unchanged. There's still **no separate Lite** build, and the **GPU Spoof** and **Legacy renderer (GLES2)** tiles stay retired. The Banner Tools grid on 6.0.9 stays **Vibration · Game ID · Audio · GOG · Overlay · Root**.
📥 Variants & install notes (9 side-by-side APKs) Each variant has its own package name + launcher label, so the variants install **side-by-side** with each other. `Original` replaces an installed GameHub; the rest install alongside it. | Variant | Package | APK | | --- | --- | --- | | Normal | `banner.hub` | `…-Normal.apk` | | Normal-GHL | `gamehub.lite` | `…-Normal-GHL.apk` | | PuBG | `com.tencent.ig` | `…-PuBG.apk` | | AnTuTu | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | `…-AnTuTu.apk` | | alt-AnTuTu | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | `…-alt-AnTuTu.apk` | | PuBG-CrossFire | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | `…-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` | | Ludashi | `com.ludashi.aibench` | `…-Ludashi.apk` | | Genshin | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | `…-Genshin.apk` | | Original | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | `…-Original.apk` | Filenames follow `BannerHub-V6-1.0.0-609-Patched-{variant}.apk`. The version string is `BannerHub v6` (product) + our semver + `-609` (the GameHub base, `6.0.9`) — e.g. `1.0.0-609`. ### Install notes - **Signing**: stable BannerHub test keystore. Arsound — мод для Android-приложения SoundCloud со скачиванием треков, своей музыкой с телефона и плейлистами, которые открываются сразу.

**Готовый APK** (ставится без ReVanced Manager) — в Telegram-канале [t.me/arsound_git](https://t.me/arsound_git). Здесь, на GitHub, — набор патчей для ReVanced Manager.

Всё делается на телефоне, компьютер не нужен. Займёт 5–10 минут.

## Установка кратко

1. Установите [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk) и [загрузчики для ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk). Загрузчики открывать не нужно — они работают внутри ReVanced Manager.
2. ReVanced Manager → **Патчи** → ✏️ → **Добавить патчи** → **Введите URL** → `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json` → **Добавить**.
3. **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** → на APKMirror: **2026.09.02-release**, **arm64-v8a**, **Download APK bundle** → **Установить**.

Ниже — подробная инструкция с пояснениями к каждому шагу.

---

# Установка по шагам

Понадобятся: телефон на Android 12L или новее, интернет (лучше Wi-Fi — скачается около 100 МБ) и аккаунт SoundCloud.

Ниже названия кнопок написаны **жирным** — ровно так, как они подписаны на экране. Если ReVanced Manager у вас на английском, в скобках указано английское название.

## Шаг 1. Скачайте и установите ReVanced Manager

ReVanced Manager — официальное приложение проекта ReVanced. Оно встраивает Arsound в SoundCloud.

1. Откройте на телефоне ссылку: **[revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk)**. Начнётся скачивание файла.
2. Когда файл скачается, нажмите на уведомление о загрузке (или откройте «Файлы» → «Загрузки» и нажмите на `revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk`).
3. Если Android напишет, что установка из этого источника запрещена, нажмите **Настройки**, включите переключатель **Разрешить из этого источника** и вернитесь назад кнопкой «Назад».
4. Нажмите **Установить**.
5. Если появится окно Google Play Защиты о неизвестном приложении — нажмите **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.
6. Дождитесь надписи «Приложение установлено» и нажмите **Готово**.

## Шаг 2. Скачайте и установите загрузчики для Manager

Это дополнение к Manager: благодаря ему Manager сам скачает SoundCloud нужной версии.

1. Откройте ссылку: **[revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk)**.
2. Установите файл так же, как в шаге 1: нажмите на скачанный файл → **Установить** → **Готово**.

Открывать это дополнение не нужно — у него нет своего экрана, оно работает внутри Manager.

## Шаг 3. Добавьте Arsound в Manager

1. Нажмите и удерживайте эту ссылку, затем выберите **Копировать ссылку** (или выделите текст и скопируйте):
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json
   ```
2. Откройте приложение **ReVanced Manager**.
3. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Патчи** (Patches).
4. В правом нижнем углу нажмите круглую кнопку с **карандашом ✏️**.
5. Внизу появится кнопка **+ Добавить патчи** — нажмите её.
6. В окне «Добавить патчи» оставьте выбранным **Введите URL** (Enter URL) и нажмите **Далее**.
7. Нажмите на поле **URL патчей**, удерживайте палец и выберите **Вставить** — в поле появится скопированная ссылка.
8. Галочку **Автообновление** оставьте включённой — тогда новые версии Arsound будут приходить сами.
9. Нажмите **Добавить**.

Проверка: на вкладке «Патчи» появилась строка **Arsound v0.8.0 • 8 патчей**. Строка «ReVanced Patches» — это официальные патчи ReVanced, её трогать не нужно.

## Шаг 4. Пропатчите SoundCloud

1. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Приложения** (Apps).
2. Нажмите на строку поиска **Поиск приложений…** и напишите `SoundCloud`.
3. Нажмите на **com.soundcloud.android**. Под названием должна быть версия **2026.09.02-release**.
   Если там другая версия — смотрите «Частые вопросы» ниже.
4. Откроется экран «Информация о приложении». Ничего менять не нужно: все патчи Arsound уже выбраны. Нажмите синюю кнопку **Патч** (Patch) в правом нижнем углу.
5. Появится окно «APKMirror — Для продолжения работы этого загрузчика требуется взаимодействие с пользователем». Нажмите **Продолжить**.
6. Внутри Manager откроется сайт APKMirror (он на английском). Дальше:
   1. Немного пролистайте вниз до «Results for …» и нажмите на **SoundCloud: The Music You Love 2026.09.02-release**.
   2. На открывшейся странице нажмите оранжевую кнопку **SCROLL TO AVAILABLE DOWNLOADS**.
   3. Появится таблица вариантов. Нажмите на оранжевую надпись **2026.09.02-release** в строке, где в колонке «Arch» написано **arm64-v8a** (обычно это первая строка). Это вариант для почти всех современных телефонов.
   4. На странице варианта пролистайте немного вниз до оранжевой кнопки **DOWNLOAD APK BUNDLE** и нажмите её.
   Реклама на сайте — это реклама APKMirror, её можно просто пролистывать.
7. Manager сам вернётся к экрану «Патчер» и начнёт работу. Вы увидите три этапа: **Подготовка**, **Патчинг**, **Сохранение** — возле каждого по очереди появятся зелёные галочки. Это занимает 2–5 минут. Не сворачивайте Manager и не блокируйте телефон.
8. Когда все три этапа станут зелёными, внизу справа появится кнопка **Установить** (Install). Нажмите её.
9. Android спросит, установить ли приложение, — нажмите **Установить**. Если появится предупреждение Google Play Защиты — **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.

## Шаг 5. Откройте Arsound

1. На рабочем столе или в списке приложений появится **Arsound** со своей иконкой.
2. Откройте его и войдите в свой аккаунт SoundCloud.
3. Настройки мода: значок профиля или **Library** → шестерёнка ⚙️ → пункт **Arsound**.

Оригинальный SoundCloud удалять не нужно — Arsound ставится отдельным приложением рядом с ним.

---

# Как обновить Arsound

Когда выйдет новая версия, Manager подтянет её сам (если в шаге 3 была включена галочка «Автообновление»). Чтобы обновить приложение: откройте ReVanced Manager → **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** и повторите шаг 4. Arsound обновится поверх, настройки и вход сохранятся.

---

# Частые вопросы

**Под com.soundcloud.android в Manager написана не 2026.09.02-release, а другая версия.**
Нажмите на com.soundcloud.android → **Выберите патчи** → в правом нижнем углу круглая кнопка со **стрелкой и часами** (сброс) → внизу появится надпись «Выбор патчей и параметры были сброшены до рекомендуемых значений» → нажмите **Сохранить**. Вернитесь назад — версия станет 2026.09.02-release.

**Строка Arsound на вкладке «Патчи» красная или пишет, что патчи не могут быть загружены.**
Проверьте интернет и что ссылка вставлена полностью. Удалите строку (✏️ → значок корзины → **Подтвердить**) и добавьте заново по шагу 3.

**Сайт APKMirror не открывается или показывает проверку «Verify you are human».**
Отметьте проверку на сайте сами, как в обычном браузере, и продолжайте с пункта 6.1.

**При установке пишет «Приложение не установлено».**
На телефоне уже есть Arsound, установленный другим способом. Удалите его (удерживайте иконку Arsound → **Удалить**) и нажмите **Установить** в Manager ещё раз.

**Android спрашивает «Открыть с помощью: SoundCloud / Arsound».**
Выберите **Arsound**.

**Трек пишет «Недоступно в вашей стране», хотя в обычном SoundCloud играет.**
В Arsound: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound** → **Сбросить данные SoundCloud**. Вход в аккаунт и настройки Arsound сохранятся.

---

# Что умеет Arsound

Всё включается и выключается в приложении: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound**.

- **Без лишнего** — нет предложений подписки Go и Go+, телеметрия выключена, вкладку Upgrade можно скрыть.
- **Скачивание** — «Скачать файл» в меню трека, проверка скачивания плейлиста без дублей, скачанное играет без интернета, лишнее удаляется из меню.
- **Поиск Arsound** — во вкладке «Поиск» переключатель «SoundCloud / Arsound»: треки, которые в SoundCloud не скачать, ищутся в YouTube Music, слушаются одним нажатием и скачиваются в «Импортированные».
- **Своя музыка** — импорт аудиофайлов с телефона, плейлист «Импортированные», любые треки в любых плейлистах, свой порядок плейлистов перетаскиванием.
- **Мгновенные плейлисты** — плейлисты и альбомы открываются сразу, даже без интернета.
- **Сеть и батарея** — свой DNS, запрет выхода в сеть с российского IP, плашка статуса сети, вопрос перед проверкой устройства, экономия батареи.
- **Плеер** — эквалайзер, статистика прослушиваний, размер и срок хранения кэша.
- **Без дубликатов** — перезаливы одного трека скрываются в рекомендациях и на главной.
- **«Для вас»** — каждый день плейлист из новых для вас треков по лайкам и плейлистам, подбирает Last.fm.
- **Оформление** — темы со своими цветами, шрифтами и анимациями, 133 иконки приложения, русский язык интерфейса.

# Что нового в 0.8.0

- **Темы переделаны.** У каждой темы теперь свои иконки, нижние вкладки и мини-плеер, приветствие и свечение на главной, полоса «Твои лайки» в цвет темы, значки в «Библиотеке», светящаяся кнопка Play в плеере и плейлистах и новый вид настроек Arsound.
- **Новый «Алый».** Почти чёрный с красным отливом, шрифт Golos Text, всегда тёмный.
- **40 новых иконок приложения** в цветах тем — теперь их 133. Настройки Arsound → Оформление → **Иконка приложения**.
- **«Arsound» — первая строка** в настройках SoundCloud.

ChMate 向け ReVanced Patch の最初の安定版です。

## ReVanced Manager での利用

1. Release assets から `patches-1.0.0.rvp` をダウンロードします。
2. ReVanced Manager の Patches 画面で追加操作を開き、「ストレージから選択」から `.rvp` を読み込みます。
3. 自分で正当に入手した ChMate を選び、`ChMate ReVanced` patch を適用します。

ZIP への展開は不要です。ChMate APK、XAPK、patch 済み APK はこの Release に含まれません。

## 主な機能

- スレッド上部と途中の広告領域を高さゼロに変更
- 広告 SDK と Firebase 計測の初期化・通信を遮断
- ChMate 本体の設定に User-Agent の保存、復元、再起動を統合

### Visual diff

**Pixel 10a (420 dpi):**
![Pixel 10a — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/screenshots/screenshots/phone-comparison.png?v=2)

**Pixel 9 Pro XL (480 dpi):**
![Pixel 9 Pro XL — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/screenshots/screenshots/emu-comparison.png?v=2)

Same `Najgorętsze` tab on both devices. **Left of each pair:** the standard
Pepper 8.13.00 deal-list (3 deals fit per screen). **Right of each pair:**
`Compact deal cards` enabled (4+ deals fit, thumbnails 92 dp, vote buttons
32 dp, denser title/price stack, skeleton placeholder bars sized to match
the real button's visible area).

This release adds patch **#7 Compact deal cards** and reorganises the prebuilt
APKs around a 2×2 matrix (debug menu × compact cards), so you can pick the
exact combination you want without flipping toggles in ReVanced Manager.

### What's new

#### Patch #7 — Compact deal cards (opt-in)
Resource-only patch that shrinks the redesigned 8.x deal-list cards and their
loading skeletons toward the denser pre-redesign density. Targeted XML edits
to `item_deal_thread_card.xml`, `item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and
`item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`.

Per-element changes (real card):

| Element | Original | After patch | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_image` | 108×108dp, marginTop=8 | **92×92dp**, marginTop=4, marginBottom=8 | smaller thumbnail with a guaranteed 8 dp gap above the comment row |
| `deal_thread_button_vote_*` | 36×36dp | **32×32dp** | thinner up/down vote pills |
| `deal_thread_text_temperature` | `Subtitle2` + minHeight 36 + body2 autosize | **`CaptionBold`** + minHeight 32 + caption autosize | 2-3 digit temperature fits the new 92 dp temperature box |
| `top_barrier barrierMargin` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | tighter gap below the optional sponsored header |
| `thread_text_title` | maxLines=4, marginTop=8, vertical_bias=0.5 | **maxLines=2**, marginTop=4, vertical_bias=0.25 | title clamps to 2 lines and hugs the top of its space |
| `thread_text_username marginBottom` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | less padding above the get-deal button |
| `thread_button_comment_count` | 48×48 dp, Start=parent | **32×32 dp**, Start=guideline_start | smaller comment button that respects the card's left guideline |
| `comment_count` | maxWidth=38, marginStart=38, Start=button | **maxWidth=42, gravity=center_vertical, height=32, Start_toEndOf=button** | comment count number renders **next to** the button instead of overlapping it via the original `marginStart=38dp` hack |
| `deal_thread_button_get_deal*` (×3) | wrap_content + Material default insets | **minHeight=40dp + insetTop=0 + insetBottom=0** + Baseline_toBaselineOf removed | the Material3 Button.Icon style ships with `insetTop=6dp`/`insetBottom=6dp` defaults — on a 40 dp View that leaves only 28 dp of orange button area, which clipped the Subtitle2 text. Zeroing the insets restores the full 40 dp visible area. |

Skeleton (`item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and `item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`):
- `placeholder_temperature_box` 108×36 → **92×32**
- `placeholder_image` 108×108 → **92×92**
- `placeholder_text_title` height 52 → **24** (single bar instead of two-line block)
- `placeholder_date / merchant / username` width 104 → **80**
- `placeholder_button_get_deal` height stays at 40 but margins drop 8 → **4**
- `placeholder_comment_and_share` 64×24 → **48×32** (matches the real comment button's 32 dp height)
- sponsored-only: `thread_header_text minHeight` 32 → **24** (smaller "SPONSORED" header bar)

All placeholder dimensions now match the real card 1:1, so the loading skeleton
snaps to the final layout instead of jumping when data arrives.

The patch is **opt-in** (`use = false`) — it only runs when you tick it in
ReVanced Manager, or pass `-e "Compact deal cards"` to the CLI.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants
The ReVanced Manager / CLI workflow obviously still works for everyone — but
because debug-menu and compact-cards are both opt-in, there are four
sensible factory combinations and we ship one APK for each:

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.00.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Every variant has the full telemetry-blocking family (T1–T10) and every other
default-on patch from v1.3.0 baked in.

### Patches in the bundle (unchanged from v1.3.0 unless noted)

| #   | Patch | Default | Effect |
|-----|---|---|---|
| 1   | Enable debug menu | **opt-in** | Re-enables the hidden 3-dot debug menu (45 dev actions). |
| 2   | Unlock tier-locked icons | on | All 12 membership-tier icons available in the picker. |
| 3   | Hide banner ads in feed | on | Pubmatic / DFPBanner ads never load; empty cell collapsed. |
| 4   | Always show event-theming icons | on | All 4 event icons available regardless of the active event. |
| 5   | Keep event icon after restart | on | Chosen event icon stays after the event ends. |
| 6   | Fix spacing around hidden ad cells | on | Companion to patch #3. |
| **7** | **Compact deal cards** | **opt-in** | **NEW.** See above. |
| T1  | Redirect tracker URLs to localhost | on | dex string-pool rewrite. |
| T2  | Neuter tracker auto-init ContentProviders | on | Vungle, Adjust, FB AN. |
| T3  | Kill Pepper first-party pixel tracking | on | NOP pixel worker + mock hwid (MD5-hex format). |
| T4  | Kill Datatransport upload pipeline | on | Crashlytics + Firebase logging. |
| T5  | Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init | on | NOP `MobileAds.initialize`. |
| T6  | Disable GMA ad-load entry points | on | NOP every `loadAd*` on AdLoader / AdManager / RewardedAd. |
| T7  | Disable Adjust SDK | on | NOP every state-mutating `Adjust.*` static method. |
| T8  | Disable PAIRIP license check | on (com.pepperdeals only) | Sideloaded US build can open. |
| T9  | Skip Usercentrics consent screen | on | CMP screen + fetch wait → straight to notif prompt. |
| T10 | Block Pepper analytics-event-report tracker | on | Retrofit `@POST` rewrite to `http://127.0.0.1:1`. |

### Files
- `pepper-patches.rvp` / `pepper-patches-1.4.0.rvp` — patch bundle for ReVanced Manager / CLI
- `pepperpl-8.13.00.xapk` — vanilla telemetry-blocked Pepper PL
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug.xapk` — + debug menu
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-compact.xapk` — + compact cards
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug-compact.xapk` — + debug menu **and** compact cards
- `manifest.json` — used by ReVanced Manager's source URL

Install the XAPK with SAI / APKMirror Installer / ReVanced Manager.

### Compatible with
All 10 sister apps from the family (Pepper PL, NL, DE, UK, FR, MX, ES, AT, SE
and the US `com.pepperdeals` build). T8 is restricted to `com.pepperdeals`
(only that build ships PAIRIP).

Hushfeed v0.61.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

A large release. TikTok 47.1.3 is supported alongside 47.0.3, and every fix made since 0.60.0 is in it.

* TikTok 47.1.3 works (#33). Every patch applies to both versions, and Morphe Manager lists both.
* Save media on a comment sticker reads TikTok's own sticker data, so it keeps working from one TikTok version to the next. The button also lightens while you hold it, like TikTok's Share and Save beside it.
* Copy comments without username works from the comment sheet's own menu again.
* On a foldable with the split comment view, folding or unfolding no longer jumps to another video when Hide seen videos is on (#26).
* Camera and microphone indicator shows on TikTok's camera screen, with a green square for the camera and an orange diamond for the microphone.
* Hide Play Store update offer is a new optional patch.
* After an update, a What's new row at the top of Hushfeed's settings opens the changelog. The settings screens had a long polish pass too.

The changelog has the full list.

## Checked

* The full test gate (2,076 runtime tests, the patch tests and both Android lint checks) passed on the commit before this release. The one change after it, the Save media press, passed its own tests.
* All 96 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and to 47.1.3 with this exact bundle, with no manifest changes. The release receipt attached here has each version's verdicts. Use 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 when patching.
* This exact bundle was installed on a Galaxy S25 running TikTok 47.1.3, and TikTok started with no crash. On the same phone, the build just before it saved an animated comment sticker through Save media, and Hook status found all 34 areas with nothing missing.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source in Manager to update. Keep the manager's existing signing key.

bd4b32186cfcffa7b47f67f0:
## What changed

**APKMirror's bundle download now patches.** APKMirror offers TikTok 46.2.3 two ways: a plain APK, and a bundle (an .apkm file) that Morphe Manager merges into one APK. The four optional cleanup patches refused the bundle (#9), because a merged bundle carries fewer files than the plain APK and only 25 of its 64 language packs. They now know that build too. Every file they empty is still checked byte for byte against the reviewed copy first, so nothing unrecognised is ever touched.

**AMOLED dark theme and bundles.** Putting everything onto a phone from the bundle showed one more problem: with AMOLED dark theme on, TikTok crashed at launch. AMOLED is the one patch that rebuilds TikTok's resources, and on a merged bundle that rebuild comes out missing about 1,400 resource files. The same patch on the plain APK is fine. AMOLED now refuses a merged bundle before changing anything and says why. Use the plain APK from APKMirror if you want the dark theme. Every other patch works on the bundle.

**Validation.** 1427 runtime tests and 240 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. The APKMirror 46.2.3 bundle takes 90 of 91, AMOLED refusing it as intended, and that build ran on a Galaxy S22 with all five cleanup patches emptying their files, logged in and playing the feed. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
